name: io.github.shieldlabs-ai/shieldlabs-mcp
title: ShieldLabs
description: Read ShieldLabs identifications and history, explain Risk Scores, verify webhook signatures.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private API Key (sec_...) of one domain, from the analytics dashboard. Enables the History API tools; without it only the offline tools run.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret Key of the domain for the Management API (optional, enables shieldlabs_get_domain_profile together with SHIELDLABS_DOMAIN).

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Registered domain for the Management API, for example example.com (optional).

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Endpoint signing secret (whsec_...) used by shieldlabs_verify_webhook_signature when no secret is passed; several separated by commas while you rotate (optional).

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: History API origin for development and tests (optional). https, or plain http for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] only.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDLABS_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Management API origin for development and tests (optional). https, or plain http for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] only.
